name: -m
--mode
options.description: Set file mode (as in chmod), not a=rwx - umask

name: -p
--parents
options.description: No error if existing, make parent directories as needed

name: -v
--verbose
options.description: Print a message for each created directory

name: -Z
--context
options.description: Set the SELinux security context of each created directory to CTX
